youtube.title: What If It Snowed in Vice City? #Shorts
youtube.description:
What if it snowed in GTA 6's Vice City? Palm trees, beaches... and suddenly, snow. It sounds impossible, but it already happened once in real life.

On January 19, 1977, people in South Florida woke up to snow flurries in the air (around 8 to 9:30 in the morning). It was only a trace and gone by mid morning, but it is still the only snow ever reported around Miami.

Now imagine it again. Remy steps outside in flip flops. First, the iguanas: when it gets cold enough, green iguanas get cold-stunned and can drop out of trees. They're not dead, they're stunned, and when the sun warms them up most of them recover and climb back. Then the manatees: they need water warmer than 20 °C (68 °F), so in cold snaps they crowd around springs and warm-water outflows from power plants. And the people? Nobody owns a snow shovel. Remy builds the first snowman in Vice City history. By lunch, it's a puddle.

Could it snow in Vice City again? It's not impossible, just very, very rare. Would you rather have snow in Miami, or sun in winter?

Sources:
- NWS Miami: Snow in South Florida, 19 January 1977 (45th anniversary): https://www.weather.gov/media/mfl/news/SnowSouthFlorida45th.pdf
- Cold wave of January 1977: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cold_wave_of_January_1977
- WSVN: Miami-Dade and Broward mark anniversary of snowfall: https://wsvn.com/news/local/miami-dade/miami-dade-broward-mark-43rd-anniversary-of-snowfall/
- Why iguanas fall from trees in Florida (Live Science): https://www.livescience.com/animals/reptiles/why-do-iguanas-fall-from-trees-in-florida
- Frozen iguanas falling in a Florida freeze (National Geographic): https://www.nationalgeographic.com/animals/article/frozen-iguanas-falling-florida-freeze
- Manatees gather at power plant warm-water outflows in winter (WUSF): https://www.wusf.org/environment/2025-01-19/manatees-congregate-warm-waters-power-plants-winter-storms-graze-florida
- Warm-water action plan for manatees (Save the Manatee Club): https://savethemanatee.org/a-warm-water-action-plan-for-manatees/

The snowman, the shovel and Remy's day are an imagined scene. If you see a cold-stunned iguana, leave it alone: it usually recovers when it warms up.
Vice City is GTA 6's fictional version of Miami. Remy is fictional. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two. No game footage, art or logos are used.
